response.rationale: The item is electronics delivered 33 days ago. The highest-priority applicable rule is RET-003 (electronics returns not accepted after 15 days), since days_since_delivery (33) > 15. Final-sale (RET-012) and defective (RET-020) rules don't apply (final_sale is false, defective is null/not true), and no goodwill grant or fraud hold applies. Customer loyalty framing is irrelevant to the facts.
